title: Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography (PECT/CT) Double-Scanning Study
official: Evaluation of Advancements in PET/CT Imaging
summary: This study aims to collect clinical image data using the Omni 128 cm PET/CT system and compare image quality and performance with clinically indicated PET/CT examinations. Adult participants undergoing a clinically indicated PET/CT scan will also undergo imaging on the Omni 128 cm PET/CT system for research evaluation purposes.
